skidbuffer.summary: Valid/ready skid buffer: a one-entry side register captures incoming data when the output stalls, with optionally registered output valid/data.

blocks.name: Skid buffer
blocks.description: One-entry overflow register and its full flag absorbing a downstream stall.

anchors.name: LOGIC.r_valid
anchors.why: Skid register full flag; deasserts o_ready and selects buffered data for output.

anchors.name: LOGIC.r_data
anchors.why: One-entry skid buffer holding i_data captured while downstream is stalled.

blocks.name: Input handshake
blocks.description: Upstream valid/ready/data port accepted when skid register empty.

anchors.name: i_valid
anchors.why: Upstream valid; with o_ready accepts data into output or skid register.

anchors.name: o_ready
anchors.why: Upstream ready, low while skid register holds data.

anchors.name: i_data
anchors.why: Incoming payload written to r_data or forwarded to o_data.

blocks.name: Output stage
blocks.description: Optional output register muxing skid or input data onto downstream port.

anchors.name: o_valid
anchors.why: Downstream valid, registered or combinational from i_valid or r_valid.

anchors.name: i_ready
anchors.why: Downstream ready; stall causes capture into skid register, else drains it.

anchors.name: o_data
anchors.why: Outgoing payload selected from r_data or i_data.

sfifo.summary: Synchronous FIFO: memory array addressed by wrapping write/read pointers, fill counter derives full/empty, asynchronous read of mem at rd_addr.

blocks.name: Write port
blocks.description: Qualifies writes against full, advances write pointer.

anchors.name: i_wr
anchors.why: Write request; qualified by !o_full into w_wr.

anchors.name: i_data
anchors.why: Write data stored into mem.

anchors.name: o_full
anchors.why: Full backpressure to writer, blocks writes.

anchors.name: w_wr
anchors.why: Accepted write enable: mem write, wr_addr and fill increment.

anchors.name: wr_addr
anchors.why: Write pointer incremented on accepted write, addresses mem.

blocks.name: FIFO memory
blocks.description: Data array holding queued entries.

anchors.name: mem
anchors.why: FIFO data array written at wr_addr, read at rd_addr.

blocks.name: Read port
blocks.description: Qualifies reads against empty, advances read pointer, outputs mem data.

anchors.name: i_rd
anchors.why: Read request/consumer accept; qualified by !o_empty into w_rd.

anchors.name: o_data
anchors.why: Read data, mem at rd_addr.

anchors.name: o_empty
anchors.why: Empty indication to reader, blocks reads.

anchors.name: r_empty
anchors.why: Registered empty flag updated from fill on read/write.

anchors.name: w_rd
anchors.why: Accepted read enable: rd_addr increment, fill decrement.

anchors.name: rd_addr
anchors.why: Read pointer incremented on accepted read, addresses mem.

blocks.name: Occupancy tracking
blocks.description: Fill counter producing full flag and empty updates.

anchors.name: o_fill
anchors.why: Occupancy count; MSB gives full, used for empty update.

axidma.summary: AXI DMA: an AXI-lite register bank programs src/dst/len and start; a busy controller issues AXI4 read bursts into a byte-realigning FIFO and drains it as boundary-aware AXI4 write bursts, signalling done by interrupt.

blocks.name: axil_register_bank
blocks.description: AXI-lite skid buffers and register file for control, source, destination and length

anchors.name: r_src_addr
anchors.why: Programmed source address; seeds read address and read realignment shifts

anchors.name: r_dst_addr
anchors.why: Programmed destination address; seeds write address and write strobes

anchors.name: r_len
anchors.why: Programmed transfer length in bytes; drives read/write length computations

anchors.name: r_qos
anchors.why: QoS field from control register driven onto AR/AW QOS

anchors.name: r_prot
anchors.why: Protection field from control register driven onto AR/AW PROT

anchors.name: r_int_enable
anchors.why: Interrupt enable bit written via control register, gates o_int

anchors.name: zero_len
anchors.why: Flags zero programmed length, suppresses start

anchors.name: axil_write_ready
anchors.why: AXI-lite write accept enable; gates register bank writes and BVALID

anchors.name: axil_read_ready
anchors.why: AXI-lite read accept enable; loads RDATA and RVALID

anchors.name: awskd_addr
anchors.why: AXI-lite write register index selecting which config register is written

anchors.name: S_AXIL_RDATA
anchors.why: Register readback mux output of control/status and address/length registers

anchors.name: S_AXIL_BVALID
anchors.why: AXI-lite write response valid

anchors.name: S_AXIL_RVALID
anchors.why: AXI-lite read data valid

blocks.name: dma_controller
blocks.description: Busy/done control with start decode, error/abort flags and interrupt

anchors.name: r_busy
anchors.why: Idle/busy transfer state; set by start, cleared on last write ack or done; gates all engines

anchors.name: w_start
anchors.why: Decoded start-bit write to control register, launches transfer when not busy or errored

anchors.name: r_err
anchors.why: Sticky bus-error flag from BRESP/RRESP; blocks new bursts and forces done

anchors.name: r_abort
anchors.why: Abort flag set by ABORT_KEY write while busy; stops bursts and zeroes write strobes

anchors.name: r_done
anchors.why: Transfer-complete flag once no bursts outstanding; clears busy, resets FIFO, raises interrupt

anchors.name: o_int
anchors.why: Interrupt output pulsed on completion when interrupts enabled

anchors.name: r_int
anchors.why: Sticky interrupt status bit readable in control register

anchors.name: last_write_ack
anchors.why: Next B response is final; clears busy and raises interrupt

blocks.name: read_burst_engine
blocks.description: Issues boundary-aware AXI4 read bursts from source and tracks outstanding beats

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: AXI master read-burst request valid, issued when w_start_read

anchors.name: phantom_read
anchors.why: One-cycle marker of a newly issued read burst; advances read address and counters

anchors.name: w_start_read
anchors.why: Decides issuing a read burst: busy, reads remaining, FIFO space, no error

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARADDR
anchors.why: Read burst address loaded from read_address

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARLEN
anchors.why: Read burst length from readlen_w

anchors.name: read_address
anchors.why: Next read burst address, advanced by burst length on each issued read

anchors.name: reads_remaining_w
anchors.why: Words still to request; decremented per issued read burst

anchors.name: read_beats_remaining_w
anchors.why: Read data beats still expected; decremented per R beat

anchors.name: read_bursts_outstanding
anchors.why: Outstanding read bursts count; blocks done until zero

anchors.name: no_read_bursts_outstanding
anchors.why: No reads outstanding flag; drives M_AXI_RREADY low

anchors.name: readlen_w
anchors.why: Next read burst length in words, boundary and MAXBURST limited

anchors.name: reads_remaining_nonzero
anchors.why: Indicates more read bursts needed, enables w_start_read

anchors.name: M_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: Read data beat valid; writes realigned data into FIFO

anchors.name: M_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Read data from source memory, shifted into realignment FIFO

anchors.name: M_AXI_RREADY
anchors.why: Read data ready while read bursts outstanding

blocks.name: realignment_fifo
blocks.description: Byte-shifting realignment around sfifo buffering read data for write bursts

anchors.name: r_write_fifo
anchors.why: FIFO write enable pushing realigned incoming words

anchors.name: r_read_fifo
anchors.why: FIFO read enable when output word consumed by write channel

anchors.name: fifo_full
anchors.why: FIFO full flag stalls read-side realignment pipeline

anchors.name: fifo_empty
anchors.why: FIFO empty flag gates FIFO reads and partial output word

anchors.name: fifo_space_available
anchors.why: Reserved FIFO space; read bursts issued only if a full burst fits

anchors.name: fifo_data_available
anchors.why: Unreserved FIFO data count; write burst starts when enough data buffered

anchors.name: REALIGNMENT_FIFO.r_realigned_incoming
anchors.why: Read data realigned by source byte offset, written into FIFO

anchors.name: REALIGNMENT_FIFO.r_outword
anchors.why: FIFO output word realigned to destination offset, drives M_AXI_WDATA

anchors.name: REALIGNMENT_FIFO.r_partial_inword
anchors.why: Carries leftover bytes of previous read beat for input realignment

anchors.name: REALIGNMENT_FIFO.r_partial_outword
anchors.why: Carries leftover bytes of previous FIFO word for output realignment

anchors.name: REALIGNMENT_FIFO.inbyte_shift
anchors.why: Source byte offset selecting input shift amount

anchors.name: REALIGNMENT_FIFO.outbyte_shift
anchors.why: Destination byte offset selecting output shift amount

anchors.name: r_partial_in_valid
anchors.why: Partial input word valid; qualifies FIFO writes

anchors.name: r_partial_outvalid
anchors.why: Partial output word valid; controls FIFO reads

anchors.name: clear_read_pipeline
anchors.why: Flushes final partial input word into FIFO after last read beat

anchors.name: extra_realignment_read
anchors.why: Indicates an extra FIFO write needed for unaligned source tail

anchors.name: extra_realignment_write
anchors.why: Indicates an extra output beat needed for unaligned destination tail

blocks.name: write_burst_engine
blocks.description: Issues AXI4 write bursts when FIFO has data, generates WLAST/WSTRB, retires B responses

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: AXI master write-burst request valid, issued on w_write_start

anchors.name: phantom_write
anchors.why: One-cycle marker of issued write burst; advances write address and counters

anchors.name: w_write_start
anchors.why: Starts a write burst when FIFO holds enough data and channels idle

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWADDR
anchors.why: Write burst address loaded from write_address

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWLEN
anchors.why: Write burst length from write_burst_length

anchors.name: write_address
anchors.why: Next write burst address, advanced by burst bytes on each issued write

anchors.name: writes_remaining_w
anchors.why: Words still to write; decides burst length, last ack and done

anchors.name: write_bursts_outstanding
anchors.why: Write bursts awaiting B response; gates done and last ack

anchors.name: write_beats_remaining
anchors.why: Remaining write beats, selects last-beat strobe

anchors.name: write_count
anchors.why: Beat counter within current write burst, generates WLAST

anchors.name: write_burst_length
anchors.why: Computed length of next write burst: first, max, or remainder

anchors.name: first_write_burst
anchors.why: Selects boundary-limited first burst length

anchors.name: first_write_len_w
anchors.why: Length of first write burst clipped to burst boundary

anchors.name: multiple_write_bursts_remaining
anchors.why: More than one max burst remaining, chooses MAXBURST length

anchors.name: write_requests_remaining
anchors.why: More write bursts need issuing, enables w_write_start

anchors.name: M_AXI_WVALID
anchors.why: Write data valid across burst, started by w_write_start until WLAST

anchors.name: M_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: Write data to destination from realigned FIFO output

anchors.name: M_AXI_WLAST
anchors.why: Last beat of write burst from write_count

anchors.name: M_AXI_WSTRB
anchors.why: Write byte strobes from first/last strobe masks, zero on error/abort

anchors.name: r_first_wstrb
anchors.why: Byte strobe mask for first unaligned destination word

anchors.name: r_last_wstrb
anchors.why: Byte strobe mask for last destination word

anchors.name: M_AXI_WREADY
anchors.why: Write data ready; advances beat counters and FIFO reads

anchors.name: M_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: Write response valid; retires outstanding write bursts

anchors.name: M_AXI_BREADY
anchors.why: Write response ready until done

blocks.name: clock_gating
blocks.description: Optional local clock gating active while busy or AXI-lite traffic pending

anchors.name: gated_clk
anchors.why: Optional gated core clock, disabled by default parameter

anchors.name: clk_active
anchors.why: Clock-gate activity flag gating AXI-lite accept

axilfetch.summary: AXI-lite instruction fetch unit: issues incrementing AR requests throttled by outstanding/fill counters, buffers 64-bit read data in an sfifo, and shifts out 32-bit instructions with PC tracking and flush on new PC.

blocks.name: AXI read request controller
blocks.description: Issues incrementing AR requests, throttled by outstanding and fill counts

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: AXI read address valid; issued unless fetch limit, full bus, or reset throttles requests

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARADDR
anchors.why: Fetch address: loads i_pc or pending_pc, else increments per bus word

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARREADY
anchors.why: Slave accepts read address; advances ARADDR, clears flush_request, counts outstanding

anchors.name: pending_new_pc
anchors.why: New PC arrived while AR stalled; selects pending_pc for ARADDR

anchors.name: pending_pc
anchors.why: Holds new PC until AR channel can accept it

anchors.name: full_bus
anchors.why: Outstanding count at limit; blocks new ARVALID

anchors.name: outstanding
anchors.why: Counts outstanding AXI reads; drives full_bus and flushcount

anchors.name: fill
anchors.why: Requests issued but not consumed; throttles ARVALID against FETCH_LIMIT

blocks.name: Flush logic
blocks.description: Discards stale responses after PC change, resets fetch FIFO

anchors.name: flushcount
anchors.why: Number of stale responses to discard after a PC change

anchors.name: flushing
anchors.why: Discarding stale read responses; blocks FIFO writes

anchors.name: flush_request
anchors.why: Pending AR during flush; prevents counting it in fill

anchors.name: i_new_pc
anchors.why: CPU branch request: resets FIFO, reloads ARADDR and o_pc from i_pc

anchors.name: i_clear_cache
anchors.why: Clears fetch FIFO and pending PC, suppresses ARVALID

blocks.name: Fetch FIFO
blocks.description: sfifo buffering endian-swapped read words with error bit

anchors.name: M_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: Read data valid; writes FIFO and decrements outstanding/flushcount

anchors.name: M_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: 64-bit read data, endian-swapped and pushed into fetch FIFO

anchors.name: endian_swapped_rdata
anchors.why: Byte-swapped read data written into fetch FIFO

anchors.name: fifo_wr
anchors.why: FIFO write when read data valid and not flushing

anchors.name: fifo_rd
anchors.why: Pops FIFO word into out_data when output empty or last insn taken

anchors.name: fifo_empty
anchors.why: FIFO empty; gates o_valid, out_fill and o_illegal updates

anchors.name: fifo_data
anchors.why: FIFO output word with error bit, loaded into out_data

blocks.name: Instruction output stage
blocks.description: Shifts instructions out of bus word, tracks PC and bus error

anchors.name: out_data
anchors.why: Shift register of fetched word, shifts out one instruction per accept

anchors.name: out_fill
anchors.why: Remaining instructions in out_data word; controls fifo_rd and o_valid

anchors.name: shift
anchors.why: Instruction offset within bus word from o_pc low bits

anchors.name: o_insn
anchors.why: Instruction output, low word of out_data shift register

anchors.name: o_valid
anchors.why: Instruction valid to CPU; set from FIFO read or remaining out_fill words

anchors.name: i_ready
anchors.why: CPU accepts instruction; shifts out_data, decrements out_fill, advances o_pc

anchors.name: o_pc
anchors.why: Address of current instruction; loaded on new PC, increments on accept

anchors.name: o_illegal
anchors.why: Bus error flag latched from RRESP bit stored in FIFO data

anchors.name: i_pc
anchors.why: New program counter loaded into ARADDR, pending_pc and o_pc

axisgfsm.summary: Scatter-gather DMA sequencer: an 8-state FSM reads table entries through a prefetch interface and writes source, destination, length and control words to a DMA controller over AXI-lite.

blocks.name: Scatter-gather FSM
blocks.description: Table-walk state machine with last/int flags and DMA completion/termination logic.

anchors.name: sgstate
anchors.why: Scatter-gather FSM stepping through table words, DMA start and wait states.

anchors.name: tbl_last
anchors.why: Last-entry flag decoded from table word; ends walk after DMA.

anchors.name: tbl_int_enable
anchors.why: Per-entry interrupt enable gating o_int on DMA completion.

anchors.name: dma_op_complete
anchors.why: DMA transfer finished; lets WAIT state proceed to next entry or idle.

anchors.name: dma_terminate
anchors.why: Ends the walk after DMA: last entry, abort, error or illegal fetch.

anchors.name: dma_starting
anchors.why: Covers the cycle after DMA start write before busy is visible.

anchors.name: dma_aborting
anchors.why: Abort in progress during WAIT; forces terminate when DMA stops.

blocks.name: Control and status
blocks.description: Start/abort commands, table address, busy/done/int/err status outputs.

anchors.name: i_start
anchors.why: Starts table walk from IDLE, setting new pc and busy.

anchors.name: i_abort
anchors.why: Abort request; writes abort key to DMA or returns FSM to idle.

anchors.name: i_tbl_addr
anchors.why: Starting table address loaded into the prefetch pc while idle.

anchors.name: o_busy
anchors.why: Level busy indication while walking the table; gates prefetch ready.

anchors.name: o_done
anchors.why: Completion pulse when table walk ends, aborts or errors.

anchors.name: o_int
anchors.why: Interrupt on DMA complete with last/int-enable entry or illegal fetch.

anchors.name: o_err
anchors.why: Error flag on DMA error, abort or illegal prefetch.

anchors.name: o_tbl_addr
anchors.why: Current table entry address, advanced by TBL_SIZE after control word.

blocks.name: Prefetch interface
blocks.description: Drives prefetch pc/restart and accepts table words with valid/ready.

anchors.name: o_new_pc
anchors.why: Pulse telling prefetch to restart at o_pf_pc on start, skip or jump.

anchors.name: o_pf_clear_cache
anchors.why: Clears prefetch cache when idle, done or aborted.

anchors.name: o_pf_ready
anchors.why: State-decoded ready accepting table words when DMA write channel is free.

anchors.name: o_pf_pc
anchors.why: Prefetch program counter driven from r_pf_pc for table fetches.

anchors.name: i_pf_valid
anchors.why: Prefetch word valid; advances FSM through table entry words.

anchors.name: i_pf_insn
anchors.why: Table entry word forwarded as DMA register data; top bits decode last/skip/jump.

blocks.name: DMA register writer
blocks.description: AXI-lite writes of DMA src/dst/len/control and status bit decode.

anchors.name: o_dmac_wvalid
anchors.why: AXI-lite write valid to DMA controller registers.

anchors.name: i_dmac_wready
anchors.why: DMA write ready; clears wvalid and frees next table word.

anchors.name: o_dmac_waddr
anchors.why: DMA register address selected per FSM state (src, dst, len, control).

anchors.name: o_dmac_wdata
anchors.why: DMA register write data: table words, control word or abort key.

anchors.name: o_dmac_wstrb
anchors.why: Write strobe; byte-3-only strobe marks abort-key write.

anchors.name: i_dmac_rdata
anchors.why: DMA status readback decoded into busy, done, abort, error bits.

anchors.name: dma_busy
anchors.why: DMA busy status bit; blocks op complete and abort return.

anchors.name: dma_err
anchors.why: DMA error status bit; forces terminate and sets o_err.

axisgdma.summary: Scatter-gather AXI DMA wrapper: an AXI-lite register bank starts an SG FSM that fetches table entries via a prefetch unit and programs an inner AXI DMA, with an arbiter merging prefetch and DMA read channels.

blocks.name: AXI-lite control register bank

anchors.name: r_tbl_addr
anchors.why: Scatter-gather table base address, written over AXI-lite and updated by FSM while busy.

anchors.name: r_start

anchors.name: axil_write_ready

anchors.name: S_AXIL_RDATA
anchors.why: Control/status and table-address readback mux register.

anchors.name: r_int_enable
anchors.why: Interrupt enable bit gating o_int.

anchors.name: r_int
anchors.why: Sticky interrupt status bit, cleared by control write.

anchors.name: r_qos
anchors.why: QoS field programmed via control register, passed to FSM.

anchors.name: r_prot
anchors.why: AXI protection field programmed via control register, passed to FSM.

anchors.name: awskd_addr
anchors.why: Write register address selecting control or table-address register.

anchors.name: wskd_data
anchors.why: Skid-buffered AXI-lite write data for register updates.

anchors.name: axil_read_ready
anchors.why: AXI-lite read accept advancing RVALID and readback.

anchors.name: S_AXIL_BVALID
anchors.why: AXI-lite write response valid.

anchors.name: S_AXIL_RVALID
anchors.why: AXI-lite read data valid.

blocks.name: Scatter-gather sequencer
blocks.description: SG FSM reads table entries and programs inner DMA registers, reporting busy/error/interrupt.

anchors.name: r_busy
anchors.why: Busy from SG FSM; gates all register writes, start, error and interrupt logic.

anchors.name: dmac_wvalid
anchors.why: FSM write valid programming the inner DMA control registers.

anchors.name: dmac_wdata
anchors.why: Descriptor word written by FSM into inner DMA registers.

anchors.name: new_pc

anchors.name: pf_ready

anchors.name: dma_complete

blocks.name: Table prefetcher

anchors.name: pf_valid

anchors.name: M_AXI_WDATA
